# QnALog 1.6.1

## Highlights

- Introduce the Log Line Q mark and align the sidebar title, recording controls, minutes board, settings, and dialogs with the active Obsidian theme.
- Improve narrow-panel layout, keyboard focus visibility, and reduced-motion handling.
- Keep the brand mark beside the title while recording, and give recent-note titles the full content width when status and retry controls are present.

## User impact

This release does not change the settings schema, API key storage, service providers, or device selection. No reconfiguration is required. Recording, transcription, note organization, retry, and existing settings behavior remain unchanged; no feature is removed.
